description:
This file contains unit tests for the MyInfoAPI class within the OrangeHRM PIM API plugin. It tests the retrieval of a single resource and confirms that other methods (update, delete, validation rules) are not implemented.

It is a test class designed to verify API interactions and behaviors related to the 'MyInfo' resource in the HRM system.

classes.name: MyInfoAPITest
classes.description: A unit test class for the MyInfoAPI class, validating the 'getOne' method and ensuring other methods throw not implemented exceptions.
